instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium full shot. In an indoor ballet studio with a wooden barre, the young girl in a black leotard and skirt (R1) sits on the floor on the left with her legs extended forward, hands on her hips, and eyes closed. Beside her, the blonde ballet instructor in a black long-sleeved top and leggings (R2) sits on the floor on the right, gesturing with her left hand while looking down at the girl's legs to instruct her. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused indoor lighting.
